about: Features owners want found. Each needs its bit values learned on a real car (Learn a feature, Changes since factory or comparing factory files) before it can go in the library. Status: wanted, being found, in library.

items.name: Open/close all windows from the key
items.description: Hold unlock (or lock) on the key to open (or close) every window.

items.name: Dial needle sweep at start-up
items.description: The speedo and rev counter needles sweep to the end and back when the ignition comes on.

items.name: Horn chirp when locking twice
items.description: A short horn sound when you press lock twice (on, off or always).

items.name: Fog lights as cornering lights
items.description: The front fog light on the side you're turning lights up at low speed.

items.name: Cruise control (with switches fitted)
items.description: Turns on cruise control after fitting the steering wheel switches.

items.name: Daytime running lights with sidelights
items.description: Keeps the daytime lights on (dimmed) when the sidelights are on.

items.name: Fold mirrors when locking
items.description: Power-folding mirrors fold in when you lock and out when you unlock (needs power-fold mirrors fitted).

items.name: Lock the doors when driving off
items.description: Doors lock themselves once the car is moving.
